[39m❯ dialog-403: before you touch the predicate, read what I just hit on this
  pane. I typed this whole message to you and hive stopped delivering into
  it. agent_send(text:) came back refusing, saying the pane is awaiting a
  choice and telling me to clear the dialog with keys. There is no dialog.
  The only reason it says that is that this message quotes the string the
  detector matches on, which is "Esc to cancel" - the footer under a real
  prompt. So: the footer half matched my own typing, and the box half went
  absent because my message is taller than the window that half reads.
  That is the whole bug, on the one pane a human types into, and it does
  not clear on its own - nothing scrolls a static screen away. Every wake
  aimed here is held past its max_wait_at for as long as this sits in the
  box. Note it is NOT the unsubmitted-text hold failing: that half reads
  the wide window and is holding correctly, which is exactly why the two
  halves have to be told apart rather than moved together.
  Do not widen the footer half to fix this.
